tasks.answer:
Spotify does NOT offer phone support for general users. The primary contact method is via email/message through their support page.

**Contact methods found:**

- **Twitter/X**: @spotify — The Spotify team is active on Twitter and provides customer support there

**Spotify's own support page states**: "Note: We currently don't offer support by phone. Send us a message and one of our customer service experts will help you out."

For corporate/business inquiries, the About Us contact page at https://www.spotify.com/us/about-us/contact/ is available.

**Summary:** No phone number is available for general customer support. Contact Spotify via their support form at support.spotify.com, email at support@spotify.com, or Twitter @spotify.

tasks.label: Find refund policy
tasks.answer: Spotify's return/refund/cancellation policy (from the Paid Subscription Terms and Conditions): Users may cancel their Paid Subscription at any time through their account page. Cancellation takes effect from the end of the billing period in which you cancel (i.e., you retain access until the current paid billing period ends). Regarding refunds: Spotify generally does not provide refunds for unused portions of a billing cycle. Specifically, there are 'no refunds available for changing from your then-current Paid Subscription before the end of your then-current Paid Subscription period,' and any unused time already paid for will be forfeited. Exceptions exist if Spotify permanently discontinues a subscription (in which case a prorated refund of prepaid fees is issued) or if the subscription was purchased through a third party (in which case the third party handles refunds). For trial periods, users must cancel before the trial ends to avoid being charged. Time window: No fixed time window — cancellation can be done at any time, with effects taking place at the end of the current billing period. No explicit refund window is offered beyond this.

tasks.label: List offerings
tasks.answer:
From the Spotify homepage (open.spotify.com), I found the following business offerings:

1. **Music Streaming** - Spotify offers a music streaming platform with a vast catalog of songs. Users can browse trending songs, popular artists, popular albums and singles, playlists (like radio stations and featured charts), and build their own music library.

2. **Premium Subscription Plans** - Spotify offers multiple paid premium tiers:
   - Premium Individual
   - Premium Duo
   - Premium Family
   - Premium Student
   These plans provide ad-free listening and additional features.

3. **Audiobooks Access** - Spotify offers an audiobooks service where users can access a library of audiobooks, available as part of their Premium plans.

Additionally, Spotify also offers a free ad-supported tier (Spotify Free), podcast streaming, and various services for creators, artists, developers, advertisers, and vendors.
